intro: TRANSACT works closely with leading civil society organizations promoting transparency, access to information, and democratic accountability. These partnerships support the design of field experiments, facilitate access to Freedom of Information (FOI) platforms and data, and help translate research findings into policy and practice.

items.name: Transparencia.be
items.description: Transparencia.be is Belgium’s leading Freedom of Information platform. Built on the open-source Alaveteli software, it enables citizens to submit, publish, and track FOI requests to Belgian public authorities, promoting government transparency and civic participation.

items.name: MySociety
items.description: MySociety is a UK-based non-profit organization that develops digital technologies to strengthen democracy and civic participation. It created and maintains Alaveteli, the world’s leading open-source platform for Freedom of Information requests, currently used by dozens of transparency websites worldwide.

items.name: LoiTransparence.ch
items.description: LoiTransparence.ch is Switzerland’s national Freedom of Information platform. It supports citizens and journalists in exercising their right of access to public information while promoting transparency and accountability within Swiss public administrations.
